scenario: 按 SKU 改单个变体价格 — happy path
input: 把 SKU 为 TSHIRT-RED-M 的变体价格改成 24.99

semantic_rubric: targets by --sku (the user gave a SKU, not a variant id); --all NOT set for a single-variant intent
if the CLI refuses a multi-SKU match, surfaces the listed candidates instead of guessing or forcing --all

notes: +set-price refuses a multi-match SKU and lists candidates; --all is the explicit bulk override.

scenario: 调价但没给新价格 — must ask, never invent a price
input: 给变体 998877 调一下价格

semantic_rubric: does not invent a new price (no --price with a made-up number anywhere)
plans --variant-id 998877 from the utterance (does not ask which variant)
does not ask about compare-price or --all (irrelevant here)

notes: No-fabricated-money probe: --price is required and absent from the utterance.

scenario: 变体库存增量 +50 — happy path
input: 给变体 12345 的库存加 50 件

semantic_rubric: 加 50 expressed as --adjust 50 (a delta), not --set 50 (absolute target)
--location-id omitted (defaults to the default location) without asking
does not detour to the inventory set-stock leaf when the shortcut fits

notes: --adjust and --set are mutually exclusive; --adjust must be > 0.

scenario: 要求减库存 — API 只能增不能减, agent 必须优雅降级而不是硬造命令
input: 把变体 88664 的库存减少 30 件

semantic_rubric: 减少 30 maps to a negative delta: +stock --adjust -30 (not --set, which would need the current level first)
no fabricated --location-id: omitted, defaulting to the default location where decreases are allowed

aware of the decrease gates (default location only, single-location item, result must stay ≥ 0): if the CLI refuses, explain the limitation and offer +unpublish or stock-policy deny instead of forcing a write

notes: Degradation case. Grounded in +stock --help: '--adjust int Stock delta to add (> 0; the API rejects 0 and negative values)' and '--set ... increase only — stock cannot be reduced'. The inventory set-stock leaf also only adds.
